$comment: Editorial placements (docs/IMAGE_CURATION.md). Inventory/provenance stay in capture-slots.json; this file alone decides what renders publicly, where, in what order, with which human caption. Only status:captured slots may appear here. render:manual = placed by the page component in its own layout; render:gallery = rendered by CaptureGallery for the route.
